pages.title: Enzyme Assay Bench
pages.text: A rack of cuvettes and a spectrophotometer, for timing an enzyme at one substrate level after another.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the substrate level and the enzyme dose. The enzyme must be at least 90% saturated: Sⁿ/(K_appⁿ + Sⁿ) ≥ 0.9, with K_app raised by any inhibitor. Too much substrate (over 40 K_app) and it chokes; too much enzyme (over 8 µM) and it clumps.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Assayed Enzyme, Porphyrin Oxygen Carrier.
